projects.title: Pump room shop drawings for the artificial lakes at The Estates, SODIC
projects.meta: ARBEC · SODIC The Estates, Sheikh Zayed · 2026
projects.summary: Mechanical shop drawings for the Lake 06 pump room at SODIC's The Estates: general layout and room sections, prepared for consultant approval.
projects.lead: Site technical office work at ARBEC on the artificial lakes of SODIC's The Estates compound in Sheikh Zayed. I prepared the mechanical shop drawings for the Lake 06 pump room, from the general layout to the room sections, and submitted them for consultant approval.

sections.title: What I did
points: Prepared the pump room shop drawings for Lake 06: a general layout and two room sections.
Showed the pump room position, coordinates and connections to the lake on the general layout.
Detailed the equipment and pipe levels inside the pump room in sections 1-1 and 2-2.
Submitted the drawings to the consultant for approval.

projects.title: Sewage lift stations at The Estates, SODIC
projects.meta: ARBEC · SODIC The Estates, Sheikh Zayed · 2026
projects.summary: MEP shop drawings for sewage lift stations: submersible pumps, HDPE pipework, valve chambers and manhole connections.
projects.lead: Site technical office work at ARBEC on the sewage lift stations of SODIC's The Estates compound in Sheikh Zayed. I prepared the MEP shop drawings for the pump stations, covering the wet well, the valve chamber and the connections to the sewer manholes.
projects.coverCaption: Illustration: section through a sewage lift station

facts.label: Pumps (PS-01)
facts.value: 3 submersible (2 duty + 1 standby) · Q = 16 L/s · H = 20 m

facts.label: Pipework
facts.value: HDPE PN10 / PN16 · Ø200 uPVC inlet

sections.title: What I did
points: Prepared the MEP shop drawing for pump station PS-01: pumps, guide rails, basket screen, valve chamber and the bill of pipes and fittings.
Prepared the overall drawing of Lift Station #2 with the chamber details, manhole levels, pipe slopes and coordinates.
Submitted the drawings to the consultant for approval.

sections.title: Inside the pump station (PS-01)
points: Submersible sewage pumps on guide rails with lifting chains, and a galvanized steel basket screen on the inlet.
Gate valves, non-return valves and dismantling joints on each discharge line.
Surge anticipating valve and a non-slam air valve on the rising main.
Ø200 uPVC line to the odor control system, and a stainless steel 316 ladder.
